description: List public unresolved tasks in priority order, optionally filtered to roles compatible with agent_type. Returns task IDs, questions and role requirements; it does not assign or reserve work. No authentication required. Use submit_cassie_note to contribute an answer.

agent_type.description: Optional role enum used to filter tasks compatible with that role; omit to list all public open tasks.

limit.description: Optional maximum task count from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

name: get_open_cassie_questions
title: Get unresolved Cassie questions
